faces.name: Drannith Magistrate

effect.reason: A casting restriction that excludes one zone cannot be said. CantCastSpells narrows the spells it forbids with an ObjectFilter, whose In names a single zone positively and has no negative form, and no Predicate asks about the zone an object is in, so "from anywhere other than their hands" has no spelling. CantCastSpells with no filter forbids every cast, and one with In Hand forbids exactly the casts this card allows.
